newsitem.title: CANADA: Enscor has terms for business sale to SMP.
newsitem.headline: Enscor has terms for business sale to SMP.

text.p: Enscor Inc said on Tuesday the previously reported US$5.5 million sale of the aftermarket and heavy duty cooling business of its wholly owned subsidiary, Equion Corp, to Standard Motor Products Inc of Long Island City, New York, will close in two stages.

It said in the first stage of the deal, which was recently completed, the assets and liabilities related to the distribution operations of the business were transferred to the buyer in exchange for a portion of the estimated sale proceeds, subject to completion of the second stage of the deal.

Completion of the second stage, involving the manufacturing assets related to the business, will coincide with the satisfaction of the remaining closing conditions and is expected to occur between October and December 1996.
